==Rewards==
Players will find artefacts within the urns, chests, and sarcophagi. Artefacts in later rooms are generally more valuable. They can be used to [[Pharaoh's sceptre#Recharging|charge]] the Pharaoh's sceptre. They can also be sold to [[Simon Templeton]] at the [[Agility Pyramid]] just north-east from [[Sophanem]] as noted items after completion of [[Easy Desert Diary]], though this is not recommended, as selling them on the [[Grand Exchange]] grants about the same returns and is faster. The [[ivory comb]] is even worth a lot more on the Grand Exchange.

===Sceptre===
Players may rarely find a [[Pharaoh's sceptre]] instead of an artefact inside a [[Grand Gold Chest|golden chest]] or [[Sarcophagus (Pyramid Plunder)|sarcophagus]]. When a player finds the sceptre, they are immediately ejected from the pyramid, as the [[Guardian mummy]] will be angry that the player has found his master's sceptre. The sceptre will be dropped on the ground under the player outside the pyramid if their inventory is full.

The Pharaoh's sceptre will appear more frequently in chests or sarcophagi in later rooms. The sceptre’s drop rates are shown below for each room.

If the player searches all golden chests as far as their level allows, the cumulative rates for obtaining a [[Pharaoh's sceptre]] per run are as below. Note that due to the lengthy animation for opening the sarcophagus, it is generally considered a more effective use of time to ignore the sarcophagus entirely until reaching room 4 due to the relatively low odds of rolling a sceptre during the first three rooms.
